cues.text: A great golden clock, bathed in white light.
From behind, the hero and his friends walk toward a bright opening.
Akihiko lowers his gloved fist and walks on.
Mitsuru glances back, then turns away.
Boots stride across a blue carpet.
Carved bull heads glint on a pillar.
Fuuka touches her headset, then follows the others.
Yukari tugs her jacket straight, arrows on her back.
Red S.E.E.S. armbands, one after another.
The hero stands still, looking up.
He turns toward a wall of light.
The team walks forward side by side.
Mitsuru, Fuuka, Yukari, the hero, Junpei and Akihiko.
